title: Cognition is the work that reduces affect

statements.text: Drive is the measure of deviation from a homeostatic set point, and the demand it makes is felt as affect, which is the origin of mind. The work that flows from affect is cognition, whose purpose is to reduce affect, that is, to reduce prediction error, bringing the world into line with predictions and predictions into line with the world, which centrally involves learning.

sources.quote: The "work" that flows from affect is cognition, the functional purpose of which is to reduce affect—that is, to reduce prediction error (free energy).
